approved_task: Submit each reward-requested frame to the existing asynchronous evaluator as soon as its prediction records, CPU-accessible labels and verified identities are ready, before map-update construction/publication. Then build and publish the map update normally. Neither branch waits for the other. One ordering change, not a new evaluator, queue or GPU optimization.

C2.label: control: UE cap on, production radar path, current ordering (compute -> map build -> publish -> evaluator submit)

E.label: treatment: UE cap on, production radar path, early ordering (compute -> evaluator submit -> map build -> publish)

decision_rule: retain / reject / inconclusive on the primary metric with the ~4-pt run-to-run spread seen between same-configuration captures (B 75.2%, C 71.4%) as context, not as a noise band; mechanism evidence must show the submission actually moved earlier; any regression in map freshness/outcomes or service failures weighs against retention

gates.G1_FRAME_ACCOUNTING: exactly 1,000 frames at TRANSMITTED_BUDGET_REACHED, or exactly 999 at a verified DECISION_CYCLE_BOUNDARY (budget 1,000, no decision cap, boundary reached); matching transmission counts, one terminal per sent frame, zero unresolved tickets (the addendum-2 rule at budget 1,000)
gates.G2_ACTOR_HASH_UNCHANGED: weights SHA-256 equals the registered value before and after; the live actor's boundary equals the binding; the read-only actor audit passes before and after and is identical
gates.G3_ZERO_IDENTITY_CONFLICTS: no profiler record (UE, edge, map) disagrees with the transmitted identity of its frame; no edge/map record names an untransmitted frame; the Phase-6 integration identity checks pass
gates.G4_COVERAGE_REPORTED: per-stage coverage, denominators and missing counts are reported for every registered stage
gates.G5_SAMPLER_REPORTED: sampler header and footer present; interval P50/P95/max, dropped samples and sampler CPU reported
gates.G6_NO_PROFILER_INDUCED_FAULT: child exit 0; Phase-6 P8 (no infrastructure fault); zero edge processing failures; zero profiler write failures, dropped records and internal errors in every process
gates.G7_INSTRUMENTATION_EVIDENCE_VALID: every profiler stream has one header and one footer; no duplicate sequence, negative interval, crossed sibling, nesting-registry violation, out-of-parent span or non-monotonic per-thread timestamp; every CUDA span resolved or explicitly marked unresolved
gates.G8_REWARD_TIMEOUT_SEMANTICS: every live actor decision replays offline to the identical mode, q_e4, state and head digests; every resolution obeys the inclusive 170-ms deadline and the registered reward formula exactly; every feedback-receipt mark equals the authoritative receipt stamp; Phase-6 P3/P4/P5 pass
gates.G9_HOST_RESTORED_CLEAN: Phase-6 cleanup gates pass (tracer, application, CARLA, radio, cold-after); sampler exited with a footer; no profiler, edge, map or child process remains

intervention.early_ordering_mechanism: a subclass of the profiled Run4EdgeProcessorV2 wraps the (already edge.compute-span-wrapped) compute callable: after it returns the materialized records list and numpy labels, and only for reward_requested envelopes after the service has published READY, it constructs the identical EvaluationTicketV2 (same envelope, context, gt_identity from the verified identities; records as bounded dict copies) and calls the live evaluator's submit (put_nowait); the base process then builds the map update exactly as before and the returned ProcessedFrameV2 carries evaluation=None so the unchanged process loop cannot submit a second time
intervention.exactly_once: per-frame identity key set in the processor; prewarm frames are reward_requested=False and the live gate is closed until publish_ready_after_warmup; holds/fallbacks have no reward request; E5 cross-checks early_submissions == evaluator.submitted and loop evaluations_submitted == 0 (treatment) or early == 0 and loop == evaluator.submitted (control)
intervention.failure_accounting: map-build/publish failures raise/count where they do today (edge_processing_failed, publisher counters); quality feedback is not treated as proof of map installation; map outcomes come from the map server as before
intervention.non_blocking: submit is put_nowait; queue-full emits the infrastructure-fault feedback synchronously exactly as today; exceptions from the early path are counted (early_submit_errors), noted in the profiler and never stop the map update
not_changed: UE child, actor, 21-D state, reward, inclusive 170-ms action-open deadline, k_min = 2, holds, 100-ms freshness limits, latest-frame admission
production CPU radar path (bundle disabled; the radar bundle is rejected for retention)
codec, precision, OAI, rendering, MPS, route, seeds, channel, prewarm
the qualified timing instrumentation (files pinned to 59f40d1) and sampling
map update content, bytes and publication path
intervention.ownership: ticket records are copies; build_run4_map_update copies again; labels are read-only in both consumers; tests assert no mutation in both evaluator-first and map-first completion orders
intervention.where: edge container only (edge_profiled_v1_ordering entry = the pinned edge_profiled_v1 main plus edge_ordering_v1 seams installed after the profiler's); both arms run this entry so the only difference is the ordering file the UE child writes into the edge scratch profiler leaf

known_limitations: the sampler classifies each PID once at first sight, so the edge container process (first seen as its entrypoint shell) is usually never matched: no edge container rows in procs/threads (matched by chance in attempt 3, not in the 1,000-frame capture); retained unchanged in both arms
one C2/E pair: engineering evidence, not causal proof; trajectories, action mixes and feedback histories differ between arms; two captures do not define a noise band

a queue overflow on the treatment arm would emit edge.feedback_emit inside edge.process (G7 nesting) — but any overflow is an INFRASTRUCTURE_FAULT that already fails P8/G6 in either arm, so this cannot change a verdict
the loop counter evaluations_submitted reads 0 on the treatment arm by construction; the evaluator's own submitted/emitted counters are authoritative

lifecycle.rationale: the collector safety timeout is a wall-clock bound on the route loop (live_cell_child, time.monotonic) and also the route's maximum loop sim-seconds; the qualified 300-frame route took ~67 s wall, so 1,000 frames need ~220 s and would stop near frame 540 at the qualification's 120 s. 600 s / 1800 s are bounds only; the 170-ms reward clock, the 2-s edge GT wait and every other timeout are unchanged.

mechanism_metrics: per reward ticket, by identity, one raw clock, two parallel branches reported separately (never summed): evaluator branch compute end -> submit -> Q_perc start/end -> emit -> UE receipt; map branch compute end -> map built -> published -> installed
retrospective check of the memo's '23 recovered tickets' hypothesis against the measured late-excess distribution
no_further_work: after the two captures: report and stop; no further optimization, retraining, Run-5 integration or additional captures; no push
objective: Measure, in one fresh control/treatment pair, whether submitting each reward-requested frame to the existing asynchronous evaluator before map-update construction/publication (one ordering change on the edge compute thread) improves whole-pipeline feedback timeliness under the retained UE-only numerical-thread cap and the production CPU radar path.

order: C2 first; if C2 fails G1-G9 do not run E; if E fails, preserve it and stop. Cold host (load < 1, no CARLA/OAI/edge/map processes) before each arm.
primary_metrics: action-open -> feedback P50/P95/P99 over received feedback; missing replies separately
regression_metrics: map publication / install latency and freshness, map outcomes
edge queue, supersessions, service failures, missing replies
retry: none. Once frames have been sent a failed capture remains a failed capture; a sampler/reporting problem discovered afterwards does not authorize a replacement run. Setup-only corrections before any frame is sent remain permitted with the failed attempt retained.
